contact-sources.heading: Contact sources
contact-sources.heading-copy: Choose the sources your firm uses to understand how new contacts found you.
contact-sources.catalog-copy: Active sources are available for new contacts. Rename and retire actions keep earlier contact history unchanged.
contact-sources.retired: Source retired. Existing contacts keep their original source.
contact-sources.save-failed: Could not save the source catalog.
contact-sources.history-copy: Renaming, deactivating, or retiring a source never changes source IDs or labels already saved on contacts.
